notes: The tutorial, 'The first morning' (GDD D-50). A fixed story on the village map that teaches the systems through its own small problems (never the gate beam, the bar or the compass). Each step: objective (the HUD), start (the device's lines as the step begins), hints (shown by the client after hint_after_s of no progress), done (the device's line as it completes), check (an outcome in the world, checked by code), and triggers (things that happen once when their condition holds: someone speaks, lends something, a sparring bout begins). A step whose check already holds when it starts completes at once.

steps.title: Awake
steps.objective: Walk a little way up the road, to where plants grow by the verge.
start: …signal. There you are. Don't be alarmed: it's me, the device you came through with. I'm damaged, but I can still talk, and only you can hear me.
You're on a road below a walled city, a very long way back in time. Walk with WASD or the arrow keys; hold Shift to run. Walk a little way north, up the road.
hints: Hover the mouse over anything to see what it is. Right-click it to look closer.
Walk north up the road a few paces. There are loose things all around: branches, a stone, a flint shard.
Keep walking north until you're among the plants growing at the road's edge.
steps.done: Everything here is real: it has weight, it's made of something, and someone may own it. Nothing is scenery just because it's small.

steps.title: Your hands
start: You arrived with nothing but your clothes, and there are loose things all along this road. Pick things up: click on them, or walk up and press E.
Your pack is along the bottom of the screen. Watch the weight: you can carry about twenty kilos.
hints: Click on a loose thing to pick it up. You walk there first.
A branch, the flint shard, a stone: any two will do.
Stand next to something small and press E.
steps.done: Good. Right-click anything in your pack to look at it; drag it onto a person or a thing to use it.

steps.title: A cry from the smithy
steps.objective: Someone is hurt at the smithy, off to the north-west. Go and speak to them.

on_start.text: Ahh! The tongs slipped. My arm, it's burning!

start: Did you hear that? Someone's hurt, over by the smithy to the north-west.
Talking is simple: click on a person, or press T and type whatever you'd say. Anything at all. There are no lines to pick from, and they answer as themselves.
hints: The smithy is up the path to the north-west, past the inn. Follow the smoke.
It's the apprentice, Jory. Click on him when you're close to start talking.
Stand beside Jory, press T, and say something: "Let me see your arm."
steps.done: Notice Mara listening in: anyone near enough can join a conversation. They'll remember what you said, and how you said it.

steps.title: Something for the burn
steps.objective: Make something that will help Jory's burn.
start: That burn needs dressing, or it will fester within the hour. You know more about burns than anyone alive here. What would you use?
To make something, press T and say what you do, in your own words. The world decides whether it works, and tells you why when it doesn't.
hints: A burn wants to be cooled, kept clean and covered. Think leaves, clean cloth, honey, clean water.
Broad plantain leaves grow by the road where you woke. Darin the merchant has linen; Hessa at the inn keeps honey. You can ask, trade, or take, but people notice taking.
Pick up the plantain leaves, then press T and type: "crush the plantain leaves into a poultice for a burn".
steps.done: That will do. You made it, so it's yours, and it exists now: nobody in this world had that until you did.

steps.title: Treat Jory
start: Now put it on him. Stand beside Jory and say what you do, or press I for Pack & gear and choose to treat him.
The same goes for you: cuts bleed until they're bound, burns fester, a broken arm holds nothing. Small hurts mend by themselves; those don't.
hints: Go back to Jory at the smithy.
Beside him, press T and describe it: "lay the poultice on Jory's burn and bind it".
Or press I: your remedy is in the pack, and Pack & gear can treat whoever is next to you.
steps.done: He'll remember that. So will Mara. Kindness counts here the way evidence does: people trust what they've seen you do.

on_done.text: That was decent of you, stranger. Kade was asking after anyone who can hold a weapon. He'll want a look at you.

steps.title: Arm yourself
steps.objective: Kade is coming over. Take what he offers and hold a weapon.

do.text: Mara says you've got steady hands. Here: a practice staff and a wicker shield. Let's see what you do with them.

start: Here comes Kade, one of the guards. Guards here are not your friends yet, but they respect someone who can stand up for himself.
Press I for Pack & gear. Put a weapon in your right hand and a shield in your left. Space uses the right hand, F the left; X swaps them.
hints: Wait for Kade to reach you, or walk to meet him.
Press I, find the practice staff in your pack, and choose Right hand.
Anything can be a weapon in a pinch: a branch, a stone. But the staff is what he's lending you.
steps.done: Weapons have a weight and a reach. A staff keeps them back; a knife needs you close. Armour matters more than anything: remember that when you meet the guards in mail.

steps.title: Kade's bout
steps.objective: Go up to Kade and spar.

do.text: Right then. Only practice: nobody bleeds. Show me.

start: Fights here happen in real time. Every blow winds up first: watch the red mark over their head, and step out of reach before it lands.
Space swings what's in your right hand. Hold F to raise the shield against blows from the front. If it goes badly, press T and say you give up.
hints: Walk up to Kade with the staff in hand.
When he winds up, step back; swing as he recovers from his blow.
Hold F with the shield facing him to take his blows, then let go and strike with Space.
steps.done: Win or lose, you know how a fight goes now. A real one won't stop at 'enough'. Choose them carefully.

steps.title: Something they've never seen
steps.objective: Show someone something that works, made from what you know.
start: Here's your real advantage: you know things nobody here has worked out yet. When people see something work, it changes how they see you.
Make something from your own knowledge, then show it to someone: say "show Hessa…", or drag it onto them.
hints: It doesn't need to be grand. Clever beats grand: a lever, clean water, a quicker way to make fire.
Ideas: a lever and a stone to lift something heavy; muddy water run through cloth, sand and charcoal; sparks from flint struck on iron into dry grass; a pulley from a rope.
Make it first (press T and describe it), then press T again: "show Jory how it works".
steps.done: Did you see their face? That's worth more than any argument. Keep that in mind at the gate.

steps.title: The city
steps.objective: Find your own way inside the city.
start: That's everything I can teach you. The city gate is to the north, and it's shut to strangers. How you get in is up to you: by what you make, what you show, who comes to trust you, or something nobody has thought of.
I'll stay quiet from here. If you're stuck, press H and ask me. I'll point you somewhere, but I won't solve it for you.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone, and everyone who saw it will remember. If that isn't what you meant, rewind from the menu: Rewind to the last calm moment.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away from the gate. It isn't over: you can still find another way. Or rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
